title: Must See Mondays – Events of The Week: Creative Time Summit, Artists Project Earth Talks & Above Bristol
content:
10th August 2015

TIP OF THE WEEK

What: Creative Time Summit (Live Stream) // Where: Spike Island // When: Tues 11th to Weds 12th August (9.30am–5.30pm) // Cost: Free (Booking Advised)

The 2015 Creative Time Summit takes place inside the 56th International Art Exhibition of la Biennale di Venezia. Taking the idea of curriculum as a starting point, the Summit engages a broad range of thinkers, artists, researchers, and activists to address what it means to produce, transform, and transmit knowledge across the conflicted terrain of the world today.

Watch the summit unfold at Spike Island inside their free screening space, with additional guest-led discussions.

To find out more then click here.

OTHER TIPS

Artists Project Earth Talks – Dealing with plastics and water pollution @ Bordeaux Quay // Mon 10th August (7.30pm) // Cost: Donation towards marine conservation projects

Dealing with plastics and water pollution: From the land to the sea Dom Ferris, Surfers Against Sewage Mohammed Saddiq, director, Wessex Water, on the GENeco waste water technology 
Jo Ruxton, producer, showing sequences from her film ‘The Cry of the Whale’ Prof. Edward Kosior, world renowned specialist on new recycling technologies Natalie Fee, TV presenter and founder, ’City to Sea’.

To find out more click here.

Above Bristol: Topographies and Landscapes @ The Gallery Space // Thurs 6th – Tues 11th Aug (3 & 8pm) // Cost: Free

Ever wondered what Bristol looks like from a balloon? Ever wondered what it feels like to peacefully drift above the city, and look down at the people below? Above Bristol sent local artists on a hot air balloon flight over the city and asked them to create a piece of art in response to their experiences, focussing on the theme ‘Topographies and Landscapes’.

We would like to invite you to the Private View on 5th August 2014 from 6-8pm at The Gallery Space, Hamilton House, Stokes Croft, Bristol. Drinks and nibbles provided.

Featuring work from: Laura Hopes, Joshua Ward, Andrew Bill, Sarah Laver, Isabel Galleymore and ana v.

To find out more then click here.
